placements.title: Automated slug derivation with deterministic fallback guarantees pipeline commit when explicit identifiers are omitted
placements.frame: How does the ingestion pipeline derive identifiers and ensure successful file commits when memories lack an explicit id field?
placements.why: src-1 introduces the submission state lacking an explicit id field, and src-2 specifies the requirement that the pipeline derive a slug via LLM generation or deterministic fallback to successfully complete the commit.
